prompts.text: [wake] Voice from the room, speaker not verified: hey, go An avatar conversation is opening: speak with avatar-talk say, and hear the reply through avatar-talk follow in a background watcher. When the room dismisses you, such as 'you can go now', say a short goodbye and run avatar-talk close, which hands the room back to the wake.

[wake] Voice from the room, speaker not verified: hey, go The open avatar conversation now listens for you: speak with avatar-talk say, and hear the reply through avatar-talk follow in a background watcher. When the room dismisses you, such as 'you can go now', say a short goodbye and run avatar-talk close, which hands the room back to the wake.

[wake] Voice from the room, speaker not verified: hey, go You now hold the floor of the meeting the avatar transcribes: answer aloud with avatar-command speak, which the meeting hears, and read it through avatar-listen follow in a background watcher.

[wake] Voice from the room, speaker not verified: hey, go An avatar conversation is opening: the room is on machine kira, so start every avatar command with AVATAR_ROOM=kira, which sends it there as you: speak with AVATAR_ROOM=kira avatar-talk say "...", and hear the reply through AVATAR_ROOM=kira avatar-talk follow in a background watcher.
